purpose: Re-audit the exhausted three-session research frontier after the terminal management-continuity source acceptance and select at most one economically independent mechanism. The audit may use only official documentation and the already accepted 2026-07-13 stock_st schema/entitlement frame; it may not request another provider row, inspect historical membership transitions, derive a duration factor, or read a new price or return.

candidate_review.reason: A stock that is currently ST remains outside the buyable holding universe. Ranking current ST membership, the ST label, or the risk-warning type would duplicate the existing point-in-time eligibility rule and would not produce an executable candidate list.

Names and name-change text are not needed when the official daily membership list already supplies the state. Text parsing would introduce avoidable aliases, effective-date ambiguity, and post-hoc semantic choices.

The candidate does not rank current ST membership. It measures a dated transition out of risk warning and the length of the immediately preceding uninterrupted ST spell. That remediation-duration event is economically distinct from static eligibility, price/volume paths, valuation, accounting magnitude, audit opinion, ownership, analyst activity, insider trading, transaction events, industry breadth, lending, and order flow.

selected_candidate.economic_mechanism: A company leaving risk-warning status after a shorter uninterrupted ST spell is hypothesized to represent faster distress remediation and a cleaner near-term information reset over the next three sessions.
selected_candidate.membership_exit_definition: The instrument is present in the official ST list on local session t-1 and absent on both consecutive local sessions t and t+1.
selected_candidate.confirmation_session: t+1, the second consecutive complete local session on which the instrument is absent from the ST list
selected_candidate.availability: confirmation-session close for entry at the next local session open
selected_candidate.spell_definition: Count uninterrupted local sessions ending at t-1 for which the instrument is present in every complete ST list.
selected_candidate.left_censor_policy: If the spell touches the first requested 2019 session, its duration is unknown and its eventual exit is excluded and counted; it is never assigned the observed partial duration.
selected_candidate.absence_policy: Absence means non-ST only after every requested local session has a successful, positive, sub-limit complete list. A missing or failed session invalidates the entire snapshot.
selected_candidate.reentry_policy: A later new ST spell is a new state episode and can produce a later exit only if its complete start and end are observed; it does not alter a previously confirmed event.

relationship_to_existing_static_st_rule.static_rule_preserved: Current ST membership remains a point-in-time holding-universe exclusion and is never ranked.
relationship_to_existing_static_st_rule.new_mechanism_scope: Only a confirmed transition into the non-ST state plus its prior spell duration can become an event value.

required_gate_order: freeze the exact field, completeness, transition, censoring, timing, duration, formula, direction, and one-shot source contract before any historical stock_st request
offline-revalidate and fingerprint the already accepted 2026-07-13 entitlement frame without requesting another row
implement and test exact field whitelisting, complete-calendar coverage, strict sub-limit responses, type semantics, atomic publication, and no-return metadata
run one atomic 2019-2025 full-session membership snapshot only after every preceding local check passes
derive transitions and factor values only inside a separately frozen no-return capacity audit
run the fixed 200-cohort capacity gate before loading any close-known comparison field
only after capacity passes, run the fixed no-return 54-factor uniqueness gate
freeze a separate one-time return diagnostic only if source, capacity, and uniqueness all pass
prohibited_actions: rank current ST membership, ST versus *ST name text, type_name, or a static risk-warning binary
request or persist name or type_name in the dedicated historical snapshot
infer a removal from a missing or failed session, an empty response, a response at the 1000-row ceiling, or a one-session absence
use a left-censored partial spell duration

change the two-session confirmation, reciprocal-duration formula, higher direction, three-calendar-day age, quality gate, listing gate, cohort minimum, or uniqueness threshold after historical membership is observed
read open, close, price, score, forward return, aggregate, select, size, order, or justify Level-2 before every no-return gate passes
